meta.title: WordPing — Vocabulary study that stays with you
meta.description: Build and review vocabulary with Word List, Flip Mode, Test Mode, local reminders, themes and High-Quality AI Voice. Your vocabulary stays on your device; no account required.

hero.subtitle: Your vocabulary stays on your device. Study with Word List, Flip Mode and Test Mode, organize results clearly, and keep learning without creating an account.
hero.ctaNote: Free download · Optional Basic and Premium subscriptions

demo.note: Save your own context, examples and memory cues with each word.
demo.testPrompt: How well did you remember it?
demo.resultDescription: The card is organized with its test result and can be reviewed with the blue filter.

features.title: A focused place for every word
features.subtitle: Manage vocabulary locally, choose the study view that fits the moment, and use test results to guide what you review next.

local.title: Stored on your device
local.desc: Vocabulary is kept locally in WordPing. There is no account and no automatic cloud vocabulary backup.

modes.title: Three ways to study
modes.desc: Move between Word List, Flip Mode and Test Mode as your review changes.

organization.title: Results that stay useful
organization.desc: Test-result colours and filters help you find Pretty good, Not really, Don’t know and untested words.

management.title: Organize your collection
management.desc: Use folders, labels, sorting and filters to keep large vocabulary collections manageable.

reminders.title: Local reminders
reminders.desc: Schedule vocabulary reminders on your device and choose a rhythm that works for you.

voice.title: High-Quality AI Voice
voice.desc: Hear supported word-card text with natural audio. New generation requires a network connection and an eligible plan.

backup.title: Backup under your control
backup.desc: Premium lets you export your own backup file and import it when you choose. Nothing is uploaded automatically.

themes.title: Themes for your study space
themes.desc: Start with free themes; Basic and Premium include the paid theme collection.

gallery.title: See WordPing in action
gallery.subtitle: Current iOS screens for organizing, reviewing, testing and editing your vocabulary.

themes.title: Make your study space feel like yours
themes.subtitle: WordPing includes free themes for everyone. An active Basic or Premium subscription unlocks the paid themes; themes are not sold individually.

access.title: Simple plan access
access.desc: Free themes stay available on Free. Paid themes are included with both Basic and Premium.

variety.title: Colours and illustrated backgrounds
variety.desc: Choose a clean solid colour or a more expressive background while keeping cards readable.

personal.title: Change it whenever you like
personal.desc: Theme choices affect presentation only; your vocabulary and test results remain intact.

how.title: From a new word to focused review

1.title: Add and organize
1.desc: Save a word, meaning, sentence or note, then place it in a folder and add labels.

2.title: Review in your preferred mode
2.desc: Use Word List for an overview or Flip Mode for focused card-by-card study.

3.title: Check recall in Test Mode
3.desc: Rate what you remember and let WordPing organize the remaining cards by result.

4.title: Return at the right time
4.desc: Use result filters and local reminders to find the vocabulary you want to revisit.

plans.title: Choose the level that fits your study
plans.subtitle: Core vocabulary study is available on Free. Basic adds paid themes and a monthly AI Voice allowance. Premium adds High-Quality AI Voice without a monthly product quota, backup, data transfer and priority support.

free.name: Free
free.description: Core local vocabulary study with free themes and promotional voice samples.

basic.name: Basic
basic.description: Paid themes and 200 new High-Quality AI Voice generations each UTC calendar month.

premium.name: Premium
premium.description: The complete plan with no monthly AI Voice quota, backup, data transfer and priority support.

features.core: Word List, Flip Mode and Test Mode

rows.studyModes: Word List, Flip Mode and Test Mode

plans.basicVoiceNote: Basic includes up to 200 new High-Quality AI Voice generations per UTC calendar month. Cached playback and promotional samples do not consume a new generation.
plans.premiumVoiceNote: *Premium has no monthly product quota. Existing per-request, per-minute, daily, technical, safety and abuse-prevention limits still apply.
plans.priceNote: Current subscription prices and renewal terms are shown by Apple in the App Store before purchase.

cta.title: Keep your vocabulary close.
cta.subtitle: WordPing is being prepared for iPhone and iPad. App Store release information will appear here when available.
